title: Inclined screw pile installation with Direct ULMPM–ABD

geometry.coordinate_frame: z-up in world; local z from tip to head

materials.name: pile
materials.provenance: steel-like inertia; rigidity penalty selected for <= 1% affine metric error, not hardware calibration

initial_conditions.initial_state: K0 overburden Kirchhoff stress from an elastic Hencky deformation, bodies initially at rest

boundary_conditions.soil: rough fixed bottom, impermeable normal-only side grid constraints and open soil surface

boundary_conditions.pile: four compliant spherical anchors track an inclined axial translation and clockwise spin viewed from head

contact_or_coupling.law: monolithic Direct MPM-ABD mesh BarrierIPC with converged lagged Coulomb friction

time.policy: backward Euler with rollback and adaptive recovery

capacities.basis: Pair caps are pilot allocations. Verify against swept BVH and accepted contact high-water marks at target backend.

validation.observable: Seven clockwise turns and 14.35 m commanded axial advance with constant 15° inclination.

invariants.expectation: strictly positive clearance above IPC dmin

validation.expectation: Track the commanded pile pose and retain positive IPC gaps.
validation.tolerance: 1% affine metric distortion and strictly positive IPC clearance.

assumptions: Kinematic installation with AR=1 and a smooth speed ramp.
Finite rectangular bed with fixed base and normal-only walls.
Pile inertia from the solid steel-like mesh.
unresolved: Site material/friction calibration, installation speed, device load limits, and boundary/refinement sensitivity.
